reviewRisk.reason: cross-screen async state, authoritative resource freshness, Attendance outcomes, and unknown mutation recovery

review.reviewer: Verify622 (fresh-context independent Spec + Acceptance re-review): ACCEPT; R52 Worker/D1 seam coverage is now present and non-vacuous

criteria.expected: One authoritative Program/cockpit resource; a committed Settings/Event/Schedule/Enrollment write is reflected in Overview, counts, next/open Event, and capability presentation without a full-page reload, and an older response cannot replace newer state.
criteria.actual: Single owner: ProgramWorkspace holds the department+modules+program+cockpit payload through useAsyncResource and refreshes it serialized on a queue (web/lib/programs/program-workspace.tsx:663-688); superseded refreshes settle as stale rather than leaving freshness unchanged (the earlier record's wording was wrong). Cockpit projects pending_enrollment_count/active_event_count/next_event/open_events (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:1489-1586); Overview consumes open_events only when cockpit.program_id matches (web/lib/programs/workspace-task.tsx:412-419). Independent verifier ran the Worker cockpit projection test (pending=1, active_event_count=4, next_event = the open Event) and the useAsyncResource stale-result tests; the canonical real-browser journeys 'settings, Event, and Enrollment mutations converge in Overview without reload' and 'keeps a successful Settings write distinct from a failed workspace readback' pass at 360/390/402.

criteria.expected: A confirmed write stays successful when the following read fails; visible data is marked stale with a read-only Retry that never replays the write; an unknown write outcome reconciles authoritative records before another mutation.
criteria.actual: Event Detail keeps the committed mutation and exposes Retry Refresh (web/lib/programs/event-detail.tsx:696-780, Retry at :1649-1651); Settings applies the PATCH result and marks reload-required/stale when the follow-up read fails (web/lib/programs/program-settings.tsx:2200-2248); unknown outcomes persist a recovery target and block dependent mutations (web/lib/programs/mutation-recovery.ts:141-173, :529-578); Attendance keeps a stale read-only projection and refuses mutations while stale/unknown (web/lib/attendance-operator-panel.tsx:1914-1919, :1996-2000, :2046-2050). Independent verifier re-ran the component cases and the real-route readback journey.

criteria.expected: Program Detail and Overview keep an Active non-cancelled Event visible while its Check-In Window is open, even after start time; several open Events are presented as a truthful choice.
criteria.actual: The server open filter uses the Check-In Window, never starts_at (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:1512-1522); Overview lists open_events with 'choose meeting' copy when more than one is open (web/lib/programs/workspace-task.tsx:477-552); participant detail keeps an Event visible while participant check-in remains open (web/lib/programs/participant-program-detail.tsx:90-93). Independent verifier ran the Worker time-boundary test (open Event started 30 minutes ago outranks a 2099 future Event; a cancelled future Event is excluded) and the component multiple-open-choice test.

criteria.expected: Package evidence is candidate-bound, and Worker/D1 tests exercise write-2xx-then-read-5xx, acknowledgement loss, out-of-order response, and current/open Event time boundaries; a fresh independent reviewer checks Spec plus Acceptance.
criteria.actual: Candidate-bound machine evidence and a fresh independent Spec+Acceptance review are complete. The Worker/D1 suite now proves a committed 2xx Event cancellation remains authoritative when an injected FROM events readback throws readback-unavailable, and proves a newer Cancelled response settles before a held older Active response with distinct updated_at revisions (web/lib/programs/programs.test.ts:12022-12065, :12183-12209). Acknowledgement loss and current/open Event time boundaries remain covered by the existing Worker/D1 cases.
evidence: agent Verify622 independent re-review: ACCEPT on R52

limitations: Focused R52 Worker/D1 seam coverage passes at candidate 4cdd7521; physical iPhone Safari / Android Chrome camera, downloaded-QR rescan, and native print remain unrun as the named completion gate shared with #625.

Two claims in the superseded 76ce0bd5 record were falsified and are corrected here: superseded refreshes settle as stale (not 'freshness unchanged'), and the cited program-settings.test.tsx:376-398 range is a Settings-group assertion, not a readback test.
Owner L2 approval, merge, deployment, release, and issue closure are outside this record.
